title: From Inexact Gradients to Byzantine Robustness: Acceleration and Optimization under Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2602.03329v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributed learning algorithms are vulnerable to adversarial nodes, a.k.a. Byzantine failures. To solve this issue, robust algorithms have been developed, which typically replace parameter averaging with robust aggregations. While generic conditions on these aggregations exist to guarantee the convergence of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent (SGD), the analyses remain rather ad hoc. This hinders the development of more complex robust algorithms, such as accelerated ones. In this work, we show that Byzantine-robust distributed optimization can, under standard generic assumptions, be cast as a general optimization with inexact gradient oracles, an active field of research. This allows us to obtain state-of-the-art results for Byzantine-robust optimization from general inexact first-order analyses.   We first show that inexact GD on top of standard robust aggregation procedures obtains optimal asymptotic error in the Byzantine setting. Goi

translated_title: 从不精确梯度到拜占庭鲁棒性：相似性条件下的加速与优化
translated_abstract: 分布式学习算法容易受到对抗节点（即拜占庭故障）的攻击。为解决这一问题，研究者们开发了鲁棒算法，这类算法通常用鲁棒聚合机制替代参数平均。虽然已有针对这些聚合算子的一般性条件可以保证（随机）梯度下降（SGD）的收敛性，但相关分析仍然相当特设化，这阻碍了更复杂的鲁棒算法（如加速算法）的发展。在这项工作中，我们证明：在标准的一般性假设下，拜占庭鲁棒分布式优化可以被转化为带有不精确梯度预言机的一般优化问题——这是一个活跃的研究领域。这使得我们能够从通用的不精确一阶分析中推导出拜占庭鲁棒优化的最先进结果。我们首先证明了在标准鲁棒聚合程序之上运行的不精确梯度下降可以在拜占庭设置下达到最优的渐近误差。进一步……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心创新在于将拜占庭鲁棒分布式优化问题统一转化为不精确梯度预言机下的一般优化问题，从而借助通用的一阶分析框架获得了包括最优渐近误差和加速算法在内的拜占庭鲁棒优化最先进结果。
